server.name: rhizophora
server.description: Rhizophora -- Architectural X-Ray for React Native. AST-driven Vein Propagation Engine that reveals hidden component structure, detects layout gaps, bridge crossings, render traps, and SharedValue lifecycle issues.

render_structural_diagram.description: Render an ASCII structural diagram showing JSX nesting, StyleSheet properties, animated styles, and layout relationships.

analyze_component_tree.description: Render a cross-file ASCII structural diagram with spacing annotations, layout properties, slot markers, and health score.

profile_screen_complexity.description: Generate a screen complexity profile (Bill of Materials) with health score and complexity grade.

trace_component_import.description: Trace a component's import chain from usage to source definition through barrel files and re-exports.

detect_boundary_gaps.description: Scan for layout gaps: hardcoded magic numbers, missing onLayout handlers, zero-height children, and design token deviations.

audit_design_tokens.description: Scan for spacing values not in the design token whitelist.

detect_absolute_overlaps.description: Scan for absolutely-positioned elements and flag potential overlap issues.

detect_bridge_crossings.description: Scan for useState/useEffect calls inside onScroll, onLayout, gesture handlers, and worklet functions.

detect_render_traps.description: Scan for inline functions, objects, and arrays passed as props to React.memo() wrapped components.

trace_shared_value_lineage.description: Trace useSharedValue lifecycle: declarations, mutations, consumption, and non-worklet mutations.

detect_nested_lists.description: Scan for nested .map() calls -- a known React Native performance anti-pattern.

audit_spacing_rhythm.description: Validate gaps using Proximity Score between siblings with Intra/Inter section rules.

audit_semantic_proximity.description: 3-variable Semantic Scoring Engine (Lexical 40% + Prop DNA 30% + Visual 30%) for sibling pair proximity.
